title: helichrysum glomeratum
intro: Helichrysum glomeratum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum glomeratum include soothing skin irritations, calming anxiety and stress, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
